concepts.name: hive
concepts.definition: The one shared Mnemion store whose patterns and entries are available to its authenticated members; its identity is separate from the member acting in it.

concepts.name: pattern
concepts.definition: An evolvable schema and organizing structure for one kind of Mnemion entry, with named facets, links, doctrine, and optional memory policy.

concepts.name: entry
concepts.definition: One stored instance of a pattern, addressable by its pattern and id and retained through updates or archival.

concepts.name: pattern facet
concepts.definition: A typed, named dimension of a pattern whose value appears on each entry; user facets are separate from automatic kernel columns.

concepts.name: link
concepts.definition: A stored, directed connection from one entry to another whose label names a declared relation, such as references or supersedes.

concepts.name: kernel pattern
concepts.definition: A system-reserved pattern, usually named with a leading underscore, whose writes are governed by the kernel policy.

concepts.name: prime
concepts.definition: Mnemion's context-based recall operation, which finds semantically relevant entries and expands their one-hop links.

concepts.name: memory policy
concepts.definition: Per-pattern settings for recall decay, conflict advisories, and facets whose active values should be exclusive.

concepts.name: supersession
concepts.definition: A behavior a declared relation carries (the kernel supersedes relation, or any relation declaring it) by which the source replaces the target as current truth, while the target and its history stay readable.

concepts.name: publication
concepts.definition: A declared public projection that queries a source pattern and renders current entries on each request.

concepts.name: ingress
concepts.definition: A declared HTTP input endpoint that transforms incoming data into entries in an allowed target pattern.

concepts.name: federation
concepts.definition: Cross-hive resolution of a Mnemion URI through an approved peer host, with host checks on redirects.

concepts.name: member
concepts.definition: A person on the hive roster whose authenticated identity is carried separately from the hive identity and used for write attribution.

concepts.name: access token
concepts.definition: A scoped bearer minted by Mnemion for remote access or narrow workflows; only its hash is stored and the raw value is shown once.

concepts.name: doctrine
concepts.definition: A pattern's required prose guidance for when and how agents should create entries and preserve its meaning.

concepts.name: consent round-trip
concepts.definition: The MCP confirmation exchange that binds a proposed sensitive write to explicit owner approval before the write proceeds.

concepts.name: view spec
concepts.definition: An agent-authored _views entry that chooses a fixed UI layout and maps pattern facets to display roles.

concepts.name: relation
concepts.definition: A declared kind of link: a name, its inverse, the patterns it may join, a cardinality and a set of behaviors from a fixed palette, held in the _relations kernel pattern. Every link's label names one.

concepts.name: route
concepts.definition: One line of the declarative dispatch table in src/index.ts: a method, a path pattern, an auth gate and a handler, matched in declaration order; the table is the whole HTTP surface.

concepts.name: store
concepts.definition: The hive's durable storage: the per-hive Durable Object's SQLite, plus R2 for document bytes, where every pattern, entry and link lives; a client-side store is a read-through cache of it, never a replica.

concepts.name: facet resolution
concepts.definition: A datetime facet's declared precision in _fields: day holds calendar days only (YYYY-MM-DD, a time of day refused at write), instant holds full UTC timestamps. Not the act of resolving a URI or a host.

concepts.name: effects
concepts.definition: The post-commit work a pattern declares in the effects registry (re-embedding for recall, cache invalidation, document tokens), composed per pattern at boot and run after a write commits, never inside the transaction.

concepts.name: upload
concepts.definition: The two-step path by which content too large for a tool call reaches a facet or the document store: a single-use upload token minted by mutate, then an HTTP POST of the bytes to /upload/{token} or /f/{token}.

concepts.name: policy
concepts.definition: A declared rule table the engine derives its enforcement from: the write-class policy that says which actor may write a kernel pattern, or a pattern's memory policy for recall decay and conflict advisories.

concepts.name: view
concepts.definition: An agent-authored view spec in the _views pattern: a view_type (board, table, list, cards) and a declarative config mapping a pattern's facets to UI roles, rendered by the web app from a fixed component palette.

concepts.name: page
concepts.definition: An agent-authored composition in the _pages pattern: a path and a list of blocks (metrics, charts, views, entries) the worker serves at /page/{path} with an Open Graph card.

concepts.name: review
concepts.definition: The derived report of what needs attention now (mnemion://review): due review hooks, overdue, due and stalled work, and alignment gaps, computed on every read and never stored; also one entry a hook records in the reviews pattern.

concepts.name: relation inverse
concepts.definition: The name a relation reads by from its target's side (serves is served-by from the goal); a link written under the inverse is stored under the canonical name with its ends swapped.

concepts.name: format
concepts.definition: How a facet's value renders in the web app (text, link, tags, date, boolean, select, number), set with set_facet_format and derived from the facet's type when unset; a publication's transport (html, rss, json, markdown) is its format too.

concepts.name: message
concepts.definition: The human-readable text a refusal or an advisory carries ({error: true, message}), and the one-line summary the review returns for an agent's briefing.

concepts.name: host
concepts.definition: The instance's authoritative hostname, configured as WORKER_HOST and never read from an inbound Host header, from which every generated URL is built; also a federation peer's hostname in a mnemion:// URI.

concepts.name: cardinality
concepts.definition: How many active links of one relation a source entry may hold, one or many, declared on the relation and enforced at the link chokepoint.

concepts.name: migration phase
concepts.definition: A numbered stage of the relations migration plan in project-docs/relations.md (1 the registry, 2 required relations, 3 reference facets retired, 4 this hive's data), each with its own restore point.
